purpose: Import published 2026 paintball layouts into Claude Code / Gridlock Coach. Images are ground truth. Coordinates are NOT invented.
how_to_import: Drop this folder into the Claude Code project root as /layouts or copy files in.
Load index.json, then events/<id>.json, then the image files listed in views[].
Do not fabricate bunker x,y. Digitize from official labeled 2D only.
